run_pre_release: run the pre-release workflow to update version across init, setup, citation, and readme files
run_post_release: run the post-release workflow to bump the version to the next dev release
run_patch_release: run a patch release by passing the --patch flag to bump the micro version number
update_version_in_file: update the version string in a single file using a named regex pattern like init or setup
get_version: read and parse the current package version from the alignment init file
